headline: 49ers vs Rams Thursday Night Football: NFC West duel opens NFL Week 4
whyCareReason: San Francisco host Matthew Stafford and the Rams in prime time at Levi's Stadium with NFC West positioning at stake.
teaser: Thursday 1 October at Levi's Stadium (8:15 p.m. ET). Brock Purdy and Christian McCaffrey host Matthew Stafford and Kyren Williams as Week 4 kicks off.
story:
Why this one matters: After a thrilling Week 3 that ended with Philadelphia's 24-20 triumph over Dallas on Monday Night Football, the NFL turns immediately to an NFC West grudge match under the Thursday night lights.

San Francisco welcomes the Los Angeles Rams to Levi's Stadium for the first domestic meeting between the division rivals this season, following their historic kickoff clash in Melbourne. Brock Purdy and Christian McCaffrey lead a 49ers offense eager to establish early divisional control, while Kyle Shanahan's defense faces a stern test from Sean McVay's aerial scheme.

For the Rams, Matthew Stafford and Kyren Williams aim to shock the Bay Area crowd and level the season series. With both teams navigating short-week preparation, Thursday Night Football promises pure tactical tension.
stakes: Divisional supremacy in the NFC West and early tiebreaker leverage ahead of the October grind.
rivalryAngle: One of the NFL's oldest and fiercest rivalries, renewed on short rest in front of a national audience.
